recipes.name: Korean Highway Rest Stop PotatoesKorean highway rest stop potatoes...
ingredients: 1 pound small baby potatoes, scrubbed clean with any blemishes removed
instructions: Place the potatoes in a medium saucepan and add enough water to barely cover them, about 1½ cups. Cover and cook over medium heat until fully cooked, about 17 to 20 minutes.
Test a potato with a wooden skewer. If it slides in easily, the potatoes are cooked. If the center is still a little firm, reduce the heat and cook for a few more minutes.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the pan. Cook over medium heat for a few minutes, gently tossing, until the remaining moisture has evaporated.

Add the butter and gently toss over medium heat until the potatoes are glossy and their skins are lightly crisp, about 5 minutes. Sprinkle with salt, give them a quick toss, and transfer them to a bowl.
Top with Parmesan cheese and sugar, if using, without stirring.
Insert a few wooden toothpicks into the potatoes and serve immediately.
